name: Smith Machine Decline Close-Grip Press
description: A close-grip press on a decline bench in the Smith machine combining locked bar path with decline angle for triceps emphasis. The Smith provides safety when training heavy decline presses without a spotter. The fixed path lets full attention go to triceps contraction.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Smith Machine Decline Close-Grip Press in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Smith Machine Decline Close-Grip Press.
steps: Step 1: Position decline bench under Smith bar. Set close grip on bar.
Step 2: Unhook bar and lower to lower chest with elbows tucked.
Step 3: Keep elbows close to torso throughout descent.
Step 4: Press bar back to lockout fully extending triceps.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Gripping too close causing wrist pain
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
